summary: Iteration 44 – Full test of Student Portal + Voucher module + Fahrkontrolle AI panel (Claude Sonnet 4.5). Backend pytest suite (9 tests) all green. Frontend Playwright E2E on portal login, dashboard KPIs, progress bars, invoices with PDF+status badges, voucher-redeem error toast, logout, portal setup invalid token, admin invite popover, and Fahrkontrolle AI panel with live Claude analysis (14s) — all working end-to-end.

minor.issue: test_iteration44_portal_ai.py silently skips when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not exported to shell env — CI-only concern, currently must run tests with the env var set (or via a conftest that loads /app/frontend/.env).

critical_code_review_comments: PortalSetup.jsx L58-60: after localStorage.setItem + navigate, window.location.reload() is called — works, but forces a hard refresh purely to re-hydrate PortalAuthContext. Cleaner would be to expose a setToken() method on the context (or call refresh()).
PortalDashboard.jsx: 'redeem' catches error but does NOT clear voucherCode on failure — that's fine, but there's no explicit invalid-code testid on the toast (test relies on generic sonner selector).
FahrkontrolleAiPanel.jsx: no dedicated loading skeleton while the initial GET on mount is in flight — user sees empty state momentarily before analysis appears; consider a shimmer or 'Lade …'.
